title: Full Stack Developer
description: About Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development. About the Role We are seeking a skilled and proactive Software Developer with strong experience in NestJS and Next.js to join our growing engineering team. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance web applications and scalable backend services. This is a full-time, fully remote position working with a global team on cutting-edge projects. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient backend services using NestJS. Build and optimize modern, responsive web applications with Next.js. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other developers, to deliver high-quality solutions. Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following best practices and coding standards. Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and contribute to continuous improvement. Ensure application performance, security, and scalability across platforms. Stay up to date with emerging technologies and propose innovative solutions. Qualifications 4+ years of professional experience as a software developer. Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript. Proven experience building backend services and APIs with NestJS. Hands-on experience developing frontend applications with Next.js. Experience working with databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB). Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development practices. Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency. Benefits Yearly Office Allowance Budget Macbook Purchase Support Wellbeing Support If you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn. We only accept CVs that are in English. Flatiron has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, color, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be disregarded

title: Backend Developer
description: PlusMinusOne is a mobile startup studio that focuses on developing and marketing its own apps that are used and loved by millions of people around the world. Our products collectively reach more than a half-million new users every month in the US market alone. Our team works in hybrid model with offices in San Francisco and Istanbul. We have been building mobile products focused on Business, Photo & Video, and Education categories in the App Store mainly for the US market since 2016. And in each of these categories, our goal is the same: provide actual value to people with the best mobile user experience. We’re in an exciting period of growth and are looking for Backend Developer who will help us shape the future of mobile. What we are looking for: 3+ years building production backend services with Node.js / TypeScript (NestJS is a plus) Solid experience with PostgreSQL and Redis — schema design, indexing, query performance Experience designing and building REST APIs Comfortable with Docker and containerized deployments; hands-on Kubernetes experience is a strong plus Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and designing CI/CD pipelines Working knowledge of AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, Secrets Manager) Able to debug real problems from logs and metrics (Prometheus / Grafana) Strong grasp of clean architecture and fundamental design principles for scalable systems Strong analytical and time management skills, and a track record of working well in an agile team Product-minded: you care about the user impact of what you ship, and you're comfortable pushing back on requirements when something doesn't make sense Great bonus if you have: Event streaming and data pipelines: Kafka, CDC (Debezium), ClickHouse or BigQuery GitOps with ArgoCD, autoscaling with Karpenter / KEDA Integrating LLM APIs into real products (RAG, evaluation, cost/latency trade-offs) Python for tooling and data work Your responsibilities will be: Building backend services for our mobile and web products from the ground up Designing and refining integrations between our applications and third-party services Deploying and operating services on Kubernetes — scaling, tuning and keeping them healthy in production Owning what you ship: monitoring, alerting and debugging your services in production Working with our event and data pipelines that power product analytics Bringing new technology and ideas to the table Influencing cross-team initiatives and mentoring mid-level and junior backend engineers Participating in planning, estimating tasks, reviewing code and pairing with teammates What we offer: Opportunity to make an impact on millions of global users' life and the future of mobile Chance to be a part of a passionate and driven team where everyone’s ideas are valued A hybrid work environment with 3 days a week at the Kabataş Istanbul office Extra 5 days of PM1 paid vacation from the first year, increasing with seniority Performance-based bonus paid twice a year Ability to own a stock option after the first year Private health insurance package Lunch and transportation allowance Reimbursement package for any education, course, sports activities, hobbies, etc. A Macbook, iPhone, magic mouse, magic keyboard, and any other hardware that you need to deliver your best work. Let's shape the future of mobile together!

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description: Senior Full Stack Developer We are seeking a highly capable Senior Full Stack Developer to join our product-focused development team. The ideal candidate has strong backend expertise—particularly with Node.js, RESTful APIs, and MySQL —along with solid frontend experience using modern JavaScript frameworks. This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong development skills, architectural thinking, security awareness, and the ability to design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, production-ready systems end to end. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js . Build, document, secure, and maintain RESTful APIs used by web and mobile applications. Design and manage MySQL databases, including schema design, indexing, query optimization, migrations, data integrity, and performance tuning. Develop and maintain modern, responsive frontend applications using React.js and Next.js . Collaborate with product and design teams to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions. Apply secure development practices throughout the software development lifecycle, following OWASP recommendations and industry security best practices . Design and implement secure authentication, authorization, session management, and role-based access controls. Protect applications and APIs against common vulnerabilities such as injection, XSS, CSRF, broken access control, insecure authentication, SSRF, and sensitive data exposure. Implement proper input validation, output encoding, error handling, rate limiting, and secure API design. Ensure secrets, credentials, API keys, and sensitive configuration are handled securely and are never exposed through source code, client applications, logs, or repositories. Identify and address security risks in application dependencies and third-party packages. Ensure application performance, security, reliability, and scalability across the stack. Review code and contribute to architecture and technical decisions. Participate in code reviews with a focus on maintainability, performance, and security. Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and continuously improve system reliability. Required Qualifications 5+ years of professional software development experience , with demonstrated senior-level experience building and maintaining production systems. Strong expertise in JavaScript and Node.js , including asynchronous programming, API design, backend architecture, and error handling. Proven experience designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs . Strong knowledge of MySQL , including: Database and schema design Writing and optimizing complex SQL queries Indexing and query performance analysis Transactions and data consistency Database migrations and production database management Solid professional experience with React.js ; experience with Next.js is highly preferred. Strong understanding of web application architecture and client/server data flow. Strong understanding of authentication and authorization , including sessions, tokens, permissions, and role-based access control. Practical knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and secure web application development practices. Ability to recognize and prevent common security vulnerabilities, including: SQL/NoSQL injection Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Broken Access Control / IDOR Authentication and session vulnerabilities Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Security misconfiguration Sensitive information and credential exposure Understanding of secure password storage, cookies, HTTP security headers, CORS, TLS/HTTPS, API rate limiting, and input validation. Experience working with Git-based version control systems and collaborative development workflows. Ability to write clean, maintainable, testable, and well-structured code. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills. Ability to take ownership of features from technical design through production deployment and maintenance. Nice to Have Experience with mobile application development using React Native, Flutter, or native platforms . Experience building or maintaining high-traffic or data-intensive applications . Experience with automated testing, including unit, integration, and API testing. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows. Experience with Docker, Linux environments, reverse proxies, and cloud infrastructure . Familiarity with security testing tools, dependency vulnerability scanning, SAST/DAST , or penetration testing. Experience with application monitoring, structured logging, metrics, and production observability. Familiarity with caching, queues, background workers, and asynchronous processing. What We Are Looking For We are looking for a senior-level engineer who takes ownership , not simply someone who implements assigned features. You should be comfortable understanding the complete lifecycle of a production application—from database and backend architecture through APIs and frontend implementation to deployment, performance, security, and ongoing maintenance. You should be able to evaluate technical trade-offs, identify scalability and security issues before they reach production, contribute meaningfully to architectural decisions, review the work of other developers, troubleshoot complex production problems, and take responsibility for the quality of the systems you build.

title: Fullstack Developer (.Net&React)
description: Job Description We are looking for a talented Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience to join our engineering team. Optimize SQL queries and improve database performance. Participate in code reviews and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Write unit and integration tests to ensure software quality. Continuously evaluate and adopt appropriate technologies and best practices. Requirements 4+ years of professional experience with .NET / C# and ASP.NET Core. Strong experience with React, including component architecture, state management, and performance optimization. Experience designing layered architectures and RESTful APIs. Strong SQL skills, including query tuning, execution plan analysis, and indexing strategies. Solid understanding of SOLID, Design Patterns, and Clean Code principles. We review applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic. Special consideration will be given to candidates with disabilities.

title: Full Stack Developer - Laravel
description: We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to join our software development team and contribute to the development and continuous improvement of our production platforms. Our technology ecosystem includes customer-facing websites, centralized backend services, internal administration platforms, partner and supplier APIs, booking and order management, payment systems, ticketing and QR solutions, automated workflows, and integrations with external service providers. This is a hands-on engineering position with a strong focus on Laravel full-stack development, APIs and system integrations . The successful candidate will work closely with our existing software engineering team and take ownership of features from technical analysis through implementation, testing and production release. Responsibilities Develop, maintain and improve production applications built with Laravel . Design and implement new features based on business and operational requirements. Develop and maintain RESTful APIs for internal systems, partners and suppliers. Integrate third-party services and external APIs. Build and maintain webhook-based integrations. Develop and improve order, booking, product availability, payment, ticketing and QR workflows. Work with Laravel Jobs, Queues, Events, Listeners and scheduled commands. Develop reliable asynchronous processes with appropriate retry, failure-handling and logging strategies. Work with MySQL/MariaDB databases, complex relationships and production datasets. Optimize SQL queries, Eloquent usage and application performance. Identify and resolve N+1 queries and other performance bottlenecks. Maintain data integrity and consider backward compatibility when changing existing functionality. Develop and maintain Laravel frontend functionality using Blade, Alpine.js, JavaScript and Vite. Investigate and resolve production bugs and integration issues. Write automated tests for critical application functionality. Participate in technical design, estimation and code review. Maintain technical documentation for important functionality and integrations. Assist with deployments and production troubleshooting when required. Required Qualifications Minimum 4 years of professional hands-on Laravel development experience. Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming . Strong understanding of Laravel architecture and framework conventions . Professional experience developing and maintaining production applications . Strong experience designing and consuming REST APIs . Strong knowledge of MySQL / MariaDB and relational database design . Strong experience with Eloquent ORM, relationships and query optimization . Experience with Laravel Jobs and Queues . Experience with Events, Listeners and scheduled tasks . Experience with Form Requests, validation and API Resources . Experience with caching and application performance optimization . Experience integrating third-party APIs and webhooks . Good understanding of authentication and authorization . Good understanding of database transactions, concurrency and data integrity . Strong Git knowledge and experience with feature-branch workflows. Experience debugging production applications. Ability to understand and work with an existing production codebase. Ability to write clean, maintainable and testable code. Good understanding of web application security principles. Ability to independently investigate and solve technical problems. Expected Technical Knowledge Candidates should be comfortable working with: Backend Laravel REST APIs OOP MySQL / MariaDB Eloquent ORM Jobs & Queues Events & Listeners Artisan Commands Task Scheduling Caching / Redis Exception Handling & Logging Authentication & Authorization Database Transactions Unit & Feature Testing Laravel Architecture Controllers Middleware Form Requests API Resources Services Service Container & Dependency Injection Interfaces / Contracts DTOs Actions Policies Frontend Laravel Blade Vite Alpine.js HTML5 / CSS3 JavaScript Development Git API design Database design Debugging Automated testing Performance optimization Secure development practices Preferred Qualifications Experience with the following is an advantage: Redis Docker Linux / Ubuntu Nginx PHP-FPM Supervisor CI/CD pipelines AWS S3 or other object storage Cloudflare Stripe / PayPal or other payment integrations SMS and messaging APIs WhatsApp / Meta APIs JWT or HMAC authentication E-commerce systems Booking and reservation platforms Ticketing and QR systems Tourism or travel technology High-volume transactional applications Engineering Approach We are looking for an engineer who can take responsibility for a feature beyond simply writing code. The successful candidate should be able to understand a business requirement, review the existing architecture, identify dependencies and edge cases, design an appropriate solution, implement it according to established standards, test it thoroughly and support its release to production. We value engineers who: Understand the existing system before modifying it. Write structured and maintainable code. Keep controllers focused and separate business logic appropriately. Use services, actions, DTOs and contracts where appropriate. Consider backward compatibility and existing production data. Handle external API failures, retries and duplicate requests safely. Consider concurrency and race conditions where relevant. Add meaningful logging and error handling. Test critical business workflows and edge cases. Consider performance and scalability during implementation. Document important technical decisions. Avoid unnecessary technical debt. Candidate Profile You should be comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with other engineers and business stakeholders. We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience working with real production systems involving multiple applications and external integrations. For example, when asked to integrate an external booking provider, you should be comfortable reviewing its API documentation, understanding the existing order architecture, designing data mappings, handling authentication and failures, preventing duplicate transactions, implementing the integration, testing the complete workflow and preparing it for production. Professional Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ownership and accountability for assigned development work. Attention to detail. Ability to communicate technical topics clearly. Ability to estimate development work realistically. Ability to work effectively with an existing production codebase. Strong focus on reliability, maintainability and code quality. Ability to learn new business domains and external systems quickly. Language Turkish: Preferred for internal team communication. English: Ability to read technical documentation and communicate effectively about software development. Position : Software Engineer – PHP / Laravel Experience : Minimum 4 years of professional Laravel development experience Focus : Backend Development, APIs, Integrations & Laravel Full-Stack Development Employment Type : Full-Time Work Model : On-Site Location : Beyoğlu, Istanbul, Türkiye We are looking for someone who wants to take an active role in building and improving production systems, not simply complete isolated development tasks.
